title: F03 · sharma_ji · Somebody Else's Son
lines: You have heard it your whole life.
First in class. Captain. Coding since he was nine.
Kabir looked at his own hands.
He could not think of one thing they were first at.
That evening Dadi was telling Pari a story.
One brother went around the whole world.
"One brother went around the whole world.
The other knew what his world was. Guess who won?
The other knew what his world was. Guess who won?"
Kabir got up and helped his mother carry the chai.
Their race is theirs. Know what your world is. That is sadhana.
